Candidates with digits only \(0,1\) and ending in \(0\), checked modulo \(7\) in increasing order:

\[
\begin{aligned}
10 &\equiv 3 \pmod 7,\\
100 &\equiv 2,\\
110 &\equiv 5,\\
1000 &\equiv 6,\\
1010 &\equiv 2,\\
1100 &\equiv 1,\\
1110 &\equiv 4,\\
10000 &\equiv 4,\\
10010 &\equiv 0.
\end{aligned}
\]

Thus \(T=10010\). Therefore,

\[
\frac{10010}{14}=715.
\]

\[
\boxed{715}
\]
